title: Don't Save the Last Dance
description: Don't Save the Last Dance — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: The new Interpretive Dance Instructor is just starting out. Go down to The Nether Crypts off of Level 5 of Balzack's Burrow and wish her Good luck. Return to the Townston Commander when complete.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Rave Reviews

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: The new Interpretive Dance Instructor is just starting out. Go down to The Nether Crypts off of Level 5 of Balzack's Burrow and wish her Good luck. Return to the Townston Commander when complete.

Offer:

Good work back there, Dungeon Runner. We now know that the Dance Lessons were prepared by a Interpretive Dance Instructor that Abadunkadunkaddonna hired. Apprently the Oroks were having a hard time following the instructions in the Dance Lessons so Abadunkadunkaddonna brought in someone for a more personal touch.

We got word that the Instructor started teaching today and set-up a studio down in the Nether Crypts of Balzack's Burrow. Why don't you run down there and wish the Instructor Good luck and Break a leg-- or two. While you are there, you should take the oppurtunity to teach her 'Drop to the Ground and Don't Get Up.' I hear it is becoming a favorite of the monsters in Balzack's Burrow.

When you are finished, go ahead and Townston Two-Step back up to Townston and check in with me, the Townston Commander.

Turn-in:

It looks like it went well! Did she like the new dance steps you taught her? I wonder what her interpretation of it was.

Objectives:

  • Wish the Dance Instructor ''good luck''

Client level range: 60–100
